CHAPTER.VERS: Meanwhile the people had gathered in thousands, so that they trod on one another, when Jesus, addressing himself to his disciples, began by saying to them:
“Teacher,” a man in the crowd said to Jesus, “tell my brother to share the property with me.”
Then Jesus told them this parable —
And Jesus said to his disciples:
“Master,” said Peter, “are you telling this parable with reference to us or to everyone?”
And to the people Jesus said:
